name: Customizable Ring for Flash Drive Cryptex

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a decagonal cryptex-style ring designed to be used as a combination lock segment. It features a ten-sided flat polygon on the outer circumference, while the inner circumference is circular with a distinct rectangular unlocking keyway gap cut into one of the positions. The ring has a low-profile flat height, making it suitable for stacking on a central shaft.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric decagonal cryptex ring in OpenSCAD with a customizable outer diameter, inner diameter, ring height, and keyway gap width. The script should support 10 positions around the ring and allow placing custom text symbols on either the inside or outside faces of the ring.
captions.factory: The code constructs the decagonal outer shape by looping 10 times, rotating and unioning linear-extruded 2D triangular polygons defined by the outer radius and edge length. It then uses the difference operator to subtract a central cylinder for the inner hole and an intersection of a rotated cube and a cylinder to form the unlocking keyway gap. Text symbols are wrapped around the ring using the write.scad library, positioned radially at 36-degree increments, and are either unioned with the ring for raised text or subtracted for engraved text.
